newsitem.title: USA: Showboat sees East Chicago losses for Q2.
newsitem.headline: Showboat sees East Chicago losses for Q2.

text.p: Casino-hotels operator Showboat Inc said Thursday that it expects to report a net loss from its East Chicago, Ind., operations for its second quarter ending June 30.

J. Kell Houssels III, president and chief executive officer of the company, attributed the projected net loss, which the company did not estimate, from a major road reconstruction accessing the area. The company holds a 55 percent stake in and manages the Showboat Marina Casino in East Chicago.
Houssels said there had been a "positive response" to the East Chicago operation since it opened on April 18 and the company was expecting "even greater revenues" from it.

However, he said, it now appears "that greater attendance and revenues will be postponed until major new road reconstruction involving highways accessing East Chicago has been completed by the Indiana Department of Transportation."
He said that as a result,"it is likely that the East Chicago operation will incur a net loss for the current quarter."
Some improvement in access is expected by late in the third quarter with full normal access being restored by late in the fourth quarter, he added.

"We remain extremely positive on the future outlook for our East Chicago property, based on the size of the market, the extremely successful opening we experienced, and the high quality physical property and customer experience we have created," he added.
Showboat through its subsidiaries owns and operates casino-hotels in Las Vegas and Atlantic City N.J., and is the largest shareholder in and manages the Sydney Harbour Casino in Australia.
